annotations.title: Ask people on an old version to update

description: Sets the lowest version of this app people may keep using, per platform, without an SDK: the app asks Ploa at start (GET https://ploa.dev/api/v1/min-version/<app ID>?platform=ios&version=<its version>, no sign-in) and gets update: true below it, with the message and the store's link to show. Without minVersion it only reads what's set; minVersion null stops asking. The answer gives the address and a few lines of code for the app to call it. Use it when a version has a bug people must leave, or an old API is going away.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

message.description: What the app shows, in the app's main language (up to 300 characters).

name: ploa_min_version
